shortBio.en: R.E.M. vocals; mumbled early college-rock delivery scaled to Out of Time / Automatic mass-alt clarity.
shortBio.zh: R.E.M. 人声；早期含混 college-rock 吐字，扩到 Out of Time / Automatic 大众 alternative 清晰度。

whyHub.en: Voice as college-rock then mass-alt face: Buck’s jangle and Stipe’s opaque-to-clear lyric arc define the band.
whyHub.zh: 人声即 college-rock 再到大众 alt 的面孔：Buck 的 jangle 与 Stipe 从含混到清晰的歌词弧线定义乐队。

body.en:
Born 1960. Forms R.E.M. 1980 in Athens with Buck, Mills, Berry. Murmur (1983) cites arpeggiated Rickenbacker under mumbled verse. Document → Out of Time / Automatic for the People (1991–92) open the lyric delivery for radio (Losing My Religion, Everybody Hurts). Berry exits 1997; trio continues to 2011.

Hub: vocal identity across indie credibility and Warner-era scale—not a guitarist hub.
body.zh:
1960 年生。1980 在 Athens 与 Buck、Mills、Berry 组建 R.E.M.。Murmur（1983）引用分解 Rickenbacker 衬含混主歌。Document → Out of Time / Automatic for the People（1991–92）为人声打开电台清晰度（Losing My Religion、Everybody Hurts）。Berry 1997 离队；三人组续至 2011。

枢纽：跨 indie 信誉与华纳体量的人声身份——非吉他手枢纽。

note.en: Founding vocals through college-rock and mass-alt eras; band ends 2011.
note.zh: 创始人声，贯穿 college-rock 与大众 alt；乐队 2011 结束。
